purpose: Quick parameter diagnostics; not ARW reviewer capability scores
selection_policy: Serial dimensions; maintain equal diagnostic correctness/completeness, require at least 5 percent lower mean request wall time to replace an otherwise valid baseline.
cache: Fresh model and KV each observation; OS cache is not flushed. Continuation uses one cold request plus two incremental turns.
token_scope: Backend API counters; potentially only the final segment for split thinking/output. Unknown remains null. These are not ARW root-thread or all-physical-engine counters.
protocol_erratum: The first two phase protocols say mode=sandbox-deny, but execution was direct Chat Completions with no tools or Codex sandbox. Frozen original protocol files are retained unchanged.
limitations: Six deterministic correctness checks on a short toy task, not review ability scoring.
Temperature-zero sampling filters and inactive penalties can be inert; no global optimality claim.
Some native CLI flags fail startup under this hardware/configuration; each failure is retained.
Parameter speed results do not establish full-review benefit or 200K long-context performance.
